body:
# Tarece Johnson-Morgan

# Board Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/Tarece-Johnson-Morgan-Board-Chair.jpeg)

- [](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Frumble.com%2Fv7ddlde-white-supremacy.html&data=05%7C02%7Cvm%40restoration-news.com%7C54ae2dbe37f647a1c12e08deec9fdc34%7C2d8170fea69a4584a3a1e9c09e7fd4e4%7C0%7C0%7C639208368508178456%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=xMDhWDOXDmw36CQ4CquPPCrmuPuw50iE4vE2mmxF0ZI%3D&reserved=0)In a [video](https://rumble.com/shorts/v7ddlde) Morgan said we “live in a society founded on the oppression of black and brown people” and we “live in a society that glorifies whiteness.” She also called white people “socialized racists.” She also said, “white people have privilege just because of the color of their skin.” She further claimed that organizations with “leadership [that] is all white” are “structurally racist.”
- Morgan [equated](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/13bae566-8fc6-410a-b9e2-efddcbb96467/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Gwinnett-Tarece-Morgan-ICE-terrorism.pdf?language=en) ICE activity with terrorism and said, “Right now many of our immigrant families are living with fear around possible ICE activity.” She then quoted Anne Frank to compare the enforcement of American immigration laws with the Holocaust.
- [Morgan said](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/14c9fc62-b0e5-4cb9-a6ef-0394210126ac/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Gwinnett-Tarece-Morgan-ICE-Raids.pdf?language=en) that ICE raids “are connected to a broader rise in antiimmigrant actions, antiDEI agendas, Islamophobia, misogynoir, and bigotry disguised as patriotism. The root is racism and hate. When we ignore or minimize these realities, we allow fear and division to take root.”
